Task 1 · 流程图 砖块制造
0% · 0 / 2 完成

描述图中实际显示的顺序。

按图中箭头作答。图示数值：干燥 24–48 小时；中温窑 200–980°C；高温窑 870–1300°C；冷却 48–72 小时。

The diagram presents the manufacture of bricks for construction.

把下句改写为 35–50 个英文词，保留真实流程，写到干燥结束：After being mixed with sand and water, the clay is cut with a wire cutter and then pressed into moulds before being heated at 200–980°C in the drying oven.

作答 1
暂时不会

只根据图示，哪一句成立？

A Every brick passes through both shaping methods.
B The complete manufacturing process takes no more than five days.
C Drying and cooling together account for between 72 and 120 hours, excluding all other stages.
D The minimum temperature in the second kiln stage exceeds the maximum in the first.
作答 2
暂时不会
答案
再练一次
